description.value:
You touch a door, window, gate, chest, or similar entryway, sealing it shut for the duration. You and anyone you designate when casting the power can open it normally; you may also set a password that, spoken within 5 feet, suppresses the lock for 1 minute. Otherwise the object cannot be opened short of being broken, dispelled, or suppressed by a release power (which suppresses this power for 10 minutes).

While locked, the object resists tampering: the DC to force it open or to pick any of its locks rises by 10.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
